spans.s: ऋत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Right, proper; 2. honest, true; 3. worshipped.

ऋत (II) n. 1. Fixed rule; 2. divine law. (this word is rarely met with in classics though its negative अनृत is common); 3. truth; 4. livelihood by picking grains in a field, ऋतमुंछशिलं वृत्तम् M.iv.4.
ऋत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Right, proper; 2. honest, true; 3. worshipped.
ऋत-धामन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
ऋतंभर m. God, the upholder of truth.
